_doc: Every number the comparison and the engine figures show. The benchmark of Origin Engine against three.js, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas, Unity Web and Godot Web overwrites this file. A value with estimate: true is drawn labelled as an estimate with its basis; a value of null with pending: true is a placeholder and blocks check.ts --final.
